locations.note: In the 1943 Allied invasion of Sicily, Vito Scaletta fights through San Celeste, an invented Sicilian town.

Vito Scaletta returns on leave from the army in February 1945 and joins the local mob through Joe Barbaro in Empire Bay, an invented city drawing on New York and other US cities, then serves ten years in prison and comes out in 1951 to work for the Falcone family.
